summary: Frontend-only regression of new luxe Admin Overzicht (/admin/overview) redesign. All 12 acceptance criteria from review_request PASS. Login → /admin/overview lands directly. Hero Kas saldo card with 3 currency tiles (SRD/EUR/USD) renders correctly with banking-style luxe gradient. 4 KPI cards (apartments=4, tenants=3, current-open=0, overdue=0) all render and navigate properly. Quick actions row works (new-invoice, new-tenant, global-search, kiosk-desktop). Global search 'kew' shows Bharat Kewalbansing + Rayshree + Yashveer huurders and HUIS 7A apartment in dropdown; clicking Bharat navigates to /admin/tenants. Active Payment Plans list shows 7 plans with count badge; clicking plan or 'Bekijk alle' navigates to /admin/payment_plans. Beheer kasgeld → /admin/kasgeld. Open Kiosk → /kiosk. Status Overzicht donut chart correctly REMOVED from desktop. Mobile (390x844) still renders portfolio-card-mobile + income-total (SRD 1.078.399,80) + outstanding-total (SRD 0,00). No console errors except expected 401 on initial /api/auth/me before login. All required icons rendered (no missing icon warnings).

issues: SRD tile shows '-6.550' (negative cash balance) — data-driven (Gopi company has negative kas) but the luxe banking-card aesthetic with a negative number looks unusual. Consider an accent/badge style for negative values or hide minus-sign formatting in luxe view. Cosmetic only — not a functional bug.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: consider styling treatment for negative cash balance in luxe hero card (e.g. red accent or '-' formatting like '−SRD 6.550').
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is now very large; consider extracting Overview(), GlobalSearch(), PaymentPlansList() into separate files under /pages/vastgoed/overview/ for maintainability.
PaymentPlansList polls every 15s via useAutoRefresh — fine for now, but ensure cleanup on unmount to avoid stale fetch on tab switch.

Global search dropdown shows 'kew' matches by partial email (Rayshree shyamkewalbansing@gmail.com); good UX, but verify it doesn't leak emails from other companies once superadmin scope is added in future.
test_credentials: admin@vastgoed.sr / admin123 (currently default-scoped to Gopi Appartement company, slug surirent). Bharat Kewalbansing, Rayshree, Yashveer are visible tenants. 7 active payment plans exist.
